## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/builds.py build` and `check` pass locally (pre-push hook enabled)
- [ ] Looked at it at 390px and 1440px (`build --include-drafts` + `serve --preview`)
- [ ] Every image went through `builds.py images` and I opened each one at full size: no windows or views, reflections, screens with notifications, post or parcels, router stickers, addresses or other people
- [ ] No secrets, private paths, hostnames, IPs or anything that locates a home
- [ ] No employer-internal material
- [ ] `drafted_by` is set if an agent drafted the post
- [ ] Prompts tested by pasting them into an agent at least once

Needs the owner's go before merge: yes (new or changed post) / no (fix)
